label: Orders
caption: MAYS, WARDEN V. ZAGORSKI, EDMUND
text: The application to vacate the stay of execution of sentence of death entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit on October 10, 2018, presented to Justice Kagan and by her referred to the Court, is granted. Justice Breyer and Justice Sotomayor would deny the application to vacate the stay.
